name: Will a tub-to-shower conversion increase my home value?

mainEntity.name: Will a tub-to-shower conversion increase my home value?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tub-to-shower conversion can positively impact your home's value, especially if it enhances accessibility or updates an outdated bathroom. Many homebuyers, particularly older individuals or those seeking modern design, prefer walk-in showers. While the exact return on investment varies by market and specific upgrades, a well-executed conversion by a professional contractor is generally considered a valuable home improvement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a tub-to-shower conversion can increase home value by enhancing accessibility and updating bathroom aesthetics, appealing to many homebuyers.
